items.lede: 2026 ED138 is way out beyond Neptune and perhaps the smallest known object of its type
items.title: Boffin's software found a possible dwarf planet - a result so rare he thought it must be a bug

items.lede: Lying beyond Pluto, 2026 ED138 could be as large as 1,500 kilometers in diameter. Astronomers are still working to confirm whether it meets the criteria for a dwarf planet.
items.title: Astronomers Discover a Possible New Dwarf Planet in Our Solar System
